name: Edge / Chrome Browser
description: Read and control an Edge or Chrome tab through the DevTools Protocol.

tools.name: browser_status
tools.description: Report whether the local Edge/Chrome debugging endpoint is available.

tools.name: browser_open
tools.description: Open a URL in a new browser tab.

tools.name: browser_extract
tools.description: Extract the visible text of the first or matching browser tab.

tools.name: browser_search
tools.description: Run a Bing web search in the browser and return result titles, URLs and snippets.

tools.name: browser_click
tools.description: Click the first element matching a CSS selector on a browser tab.

tools.name: browser_fill
tools.description: Fill an input, textarea or contenteditable element and dispatch input/change events.

tools.name: browser_wait_for
tools.description: Wait until a CSS selector appears, up to 30 seconds.

tools.name: browser_reload
tools.description: Reload a browser tab, bypassing cache.

tools.name: browser_back
tools.description: Navigate a browser tab back in history.

tools.name: browser_forward
tools.description: Navigate a browser tab forward in history.
